dict.string: healthOS connects to your WHOOP's Heart Rate Broadcast (or another Bluetooth heart rate sensor) to show your heart rate live while that screen is open.

healthOS uses the camera to scan food barcodes, photograph a meal to estimate it, take a reference photo for your portrait, and photograph a paper lab report to read its results. A meal photo is used for that estimate only; reference photos and lab reports are kept in your healthOS account until you delete them.
healthOS reads your Health data and sends daily summaries to your healthOS dashboard.
healthOS saves the food and drink you log in healthOS to Apple Health.
healthOS can send your Health data to a healthOS server on your local network.
healthOS uses the microphone only while you hold to record a voice note about what you ate. The recording is sent once to be turned into words, and healthOS never stores or logs it.
